sections.title: ① Concept Explanation
sections.body: **Planning** in agents refers to the process of decomposing a high-level goal into an ordered sequence of subtasks, identifying dependencies between them, and determining which tools and resources are needed for each. Effective planning separates the "what to do" (plan generation) from the "how to do it" (execution), enabling agents to tackle complex, multi-step tasks that would overwhelm a simple ReAct loop. There are two dominant patterns: **Plan-and-Execute** (generate the full plan upfront, then execute step-by-step) and **Online Planning** (re-plan after each step based on observations). Plan-and-Execute is more efficient (fewer LLM calls) but fragile to unexpected tool results; Online Planning is adaptive but expensive. Production agents often use a hybrid: generate an initial high-level plan, then use online re-planning only when a step fails or produces unexpected results.

sections.title: ④ Visual Explanation
sections.body:
```
AGENT PLANNING: DECOMPOSITION & EXECUTION
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

HIGH-LEVEL GOAL: "Generate Q1 2026 financial report for AAPL"
                              │
                    PLANNING PHASE (LLM)
                              │
            ┌─────────────────┼─────────────────┐
            │                 │                 │
            ▼                 ▼                 ▼
      Step 1:           Step 2:           Step 3:
  Fetch Q1 data      Calculate KPIs    Write Report
  (search_web)       (calculate)       (write_report)
  depends_on: []     depends_on: [1]   depends_on: [1,2]

                    EXECUTION PHASE
                              │
            ┌─────────────────┘
            │
Step 1: search_web("AAPL Q1 2026 earnings") → {"revenue": "$124B", ...}
            │
            ▼ (Step 2 unlocked)
Step 2: calculate("revenue_growth=(124-118)/118*100") → "5.08%"
            │
            ▼ (Step 3 unlocked)
Step 3: write_report(data={"revenue": "$124B", "growth": "5.08%"}) → report.pdf

PLAN-AND-EXECUTE vs ONLINE PLANNING:
═════════════════════════════════════
Plan-and-Execute:                Online Planning:
  Goal → [Full Plan] → Execute     Goal → Step1 → Observe → Replan → Step2...
  ✅ Fewer LLM calls               ✅ Adapts to surprises
  ✅ Parallelizable steps           ❌ More LLM calls
  ❌ Brittle if plan fails          ❌ Slower
  Best for: predictable tasks      Best for: exploratory tasks
```
